text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're a few days into summer camp, and I
find that it's totally silent
tonight as I go to
get some water. The whole camp must be
sleeping soundly after training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But as I walk through the eerily empty
lobby in search of a drink, I
feel a chill run
up my spine...
I... cuuurse... youuu...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha,
just the reaction I was hoping for.
You scare easily, huh,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't look at me like that. I was only
playing. Forgive me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't get to sleep and was bored out
of my mind. That is, until
you came along!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry—I'm not nervous or
anything. But this might be the
perfect
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come for a walk with me? Let's enjoy the
night air.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a wonderful evening. I haven't
had a night to myself like this
since we got
here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I may be a student, but my duties as a
dorm leader are many. Some of
my darling
ponies need lots of comforting to sleep in
unfamiliar beds.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But just for tonight,
I'd like to forget my
responsibilities and have you
all to myself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm serious. There's something I
want to show you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Say, let's race to the beach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surprised as I am,
I follow after her as fast
as I can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She really deserves her nickname, the
Black Meteor. Her running is
elegant, yet
powerful. There's not an ounce of
hesitation in it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it's wrapped in a relentless
passion to
race.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the rippling waves is so
comforting. This really is a
wonderful
night.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? I wanted you to see
the fruits of our training here.
I've been
having the time of life running these last
few days.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So? Did my running excite you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I need to tell you something. It's
important.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking ever since that student
got injured and had to
leave the academy.
She entrusted her dream to me, as you
may recall.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of how I can carry on her dream
has confounded me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But when we saw that play together, I
realized what I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki, the greatest entertainer, who
brings joy to the world...
That's who I want
to become.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But this dream of mine continues beyond
that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Making people happy, healing their
woes—that's what I want to do.
And I also
want to carry on their dreams when they
themselves can't.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: For that purpose, I cannot lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to continue to run—always—and
win as many races as I can!
And when I rise
as a star...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to obtain every racer's
dream—proof of being the greatest.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I will win the Triple Crown. That will be the ultimate realization of my dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown is a title given to
runners who triumph in the three
most prestigious
races—the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese
Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the history of the Twinkle Series,
only a
rare few have ever
achieved it. It's truly
the greatest honor every racer aspires to!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is what I swear to you tonight.
I need
you to act as my witness.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: There. Now that it's in words, I must make it come true. To fail to meet your expectations would be my greatest defeat!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So I have to start training seriously,
and I
need you to keep me on my
path!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, I watch as she practices for a
while, and I see a new light
of passion
burning in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I want to keep going,
but I'm afraid
it'll be light soon.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, a great dream lies before
me. I feel I can almost reach
out and
snatch it from the very air.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All I want to do is keep running.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll ask you again, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Guide me on my path. Be my number-one
supporter, my
partner—always stay by my
side!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Then on my name as the greatest entertainer, I promise to bring you the most joy of all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You'll have a front-row seat to my
marvelous miracle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our partnership feels like it's just
beginning. From here on out, we're
going
after the biggest dream our hearts can
imagine.
